Budget Plan for Derrick's Rock Climbing Hobby

Initial Costs (One-time purchases):
1. Climbing Shoes: $80 - $150
2. Harness: $50 - $100
3. Carabiners (set of 5-8): $40 - $80
4. Ropes (dynamic climbing rope, 60m): $150 - $250
5. Helmet: $40 - $80
Total Initial Investment: Approximately $360 - $660

Ongoing Costs:
1. Gym Membership or Outdoor Access Fees: $30 - $60 per month
2. Chalk and Chalk Bag: $10 - $20 per month
3. Maintenance and Gear Replacement (shoes wear out every 6-12 months, ropes every 5-7 years): Average $20 - $40 per month
4. Optional: Coaching or Workshops: $50 - $150 per session (occasional)

Estimated Monthly Ongoing Cost: $60 - $120

Most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat: Banana
